tools.name: scalefusion_list_devices
tools.description: List the devices managed by Scalefusion with their ids, names, status, battery, model and IMEI. Start here: the device ids feed most other tools. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_get_device
tools.description: Get the full record of one managed device: name, model, OS, status, group, profile, IMEI and serial number. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_search_devices
tools.description: Find managed devices by IMEI or serial number. Give at least one of the two. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/search.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_get_device_battery
tools.description: Get the battery level and charging information of one device. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/battery.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_get_device_locations
tools.description: Get the latest 10 recorded locations of one device. Location data is personal data: use it only for managed devices the user is allowed to track. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/locations.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_get_device_monthly_data_usage
tools.description: Get the mobile data usage of one Android or iOS device for the current month. Developer API: GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/monthly_data_usage.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_list_device_profiles
tools.description: List the device profiles (policy sets) in the account with their ids and names. Developer API: GET /api/v1/device_profiles.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_list_device_groups
tools.description: List the device groups in the account with their ids, names and linked profile ids. Developer API: GET /api/v1/device_groups.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_lock_devices
tools.description: LOCK one or more devices now: applies their policies, so the user cannot use the device normally until it is unlocked. Affects real devices in the field. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/lock.json (device_ids[]).

tools.name: scalefusion_unlock_devices
tools.description: UNLOCK one or more devices now: relaxes their policies so the user can use the device again. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/unlock.json (device_ids[]).

tools.name: scalefusion_reboot_device
tools.description: REBOOT one device now. Works only on supported devices. Unsaved work on the device can be lost. Developer API: PUT /api/v1/devices/{id}/reboot.json.

tools.name: scalefusion_change_device_group
tools.description: MOVE one device to another device group. The group's profile policies then apply to the device. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/change_group.json (device[device_group_id]).

tools.name: scalefusion_update_exit_passcode
tools.description: SET the exit passcode of one device that has no device profile. The new passcode replaces the old one; the user then needs it to leave managed mode. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/update_exit_passcode.json (passcode).

tools.name: scalefusion_clear_app_data
tools.description: CLEAR the stored data of the listed apps on the listed devices (for example local caches and sign-ins). Unsaved app data is lost. Developer API: POST /api/v1/devices/clear_app_data.json (device_ids[], packages[]).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scalefusion_list_devices · Private data: scalefusion_get_device · Public sink: scalefusion_lock_devices, scalefusion_unlock_devices, scalefusion_change_device_group, scalefusion_update_exit_passcode, scalefusion_clear_app_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scalefusion_list_devices · Private data: scalefusion_get_device · Public sink: scalefusion_lock_devices, scalefusion_unlock_devices, scalefusion_change_device_group, scalefusion_update_exit_passcode, scalefusion_clear_app_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
